raw_text: Sutter Med Plaza bldg B. RTU-3 not cooling. Found low charge, leak at suction line braze. Repaired and recharged 6 lbs 410a. Unit cooling 55 supply. 3.5 hrs
went back out to riverside, got it running
Cordova Business Park. PM on both units. Changed filters (8) belts looked ok. Coils washed. No issues found. 2

Delta Foods cold side. Compressor locked out on the Carrier 48TC, megged the windings, shorted to ground. Compressor is toast. Unit tag says 2022 install. Ordered replacement comp from Johnstone, will return Thursday. 2 hrs diag today.
Hillview Dental - thermostat dead. Replaced with T6 pro. 1hr
Called out to the old bakery on 16th. Nobody there when I arrived, waited 40 min, left card. Will reschedule

Delta Foods - installed replacement compressor on 48TC. Evacuated, recharged, checked superheat and subcool both in range. Running good. 5.5 hrs. Also noticed the condenser fan motor on unit 2 is getting loud, should be looked at.
Sutter Med Plaza. Filter change all 6 rtus. 2.5
Greenfield Elementary gym unit. Blower not running. Bad capacitor, replaced 45/5. Also belt was shredded, put on a new A38. About an hour and a half

tenant complaint 4th floor too warm at westbrook tower. checked zone damper actuator, it was stuck. freed it up and cycled. seems fine now but the actuator is original and will fail again. recommend replacement. 2 hr
Mission Linen. The big Trane on the roof. Found the economizer stuck full open, that's why they were freezing. Actuator bad, jumpered it closed as a temp fix. Need to order a Belimo. 1.5
pm
Cordova Business Park suite 110. No heat complaint. Igniter cracked. Replaced ignitor and flame sensor while I was in there. Cycled 3 times ok. 2 hrs

Riverside Family Practice. This is the third time out on this unit. The Goodman 4 ton, serial 1905123456. Coil is leaking again. I patched it last time and it's leaking in a different spot now. Honestly this coil needs to be replaced, it's got formicary corrosion all through it. Unit was put in Nov 2021 so the coil should still be covered, it's a 5 year on parts. Recommend we pull warranty on it. Spent 2 hours chasing the leak and recharging, 3 lbs of 410.
Westbrook Tower - replaced zone damper actuator on 4th floor per last visit. Belimo LMB24-3. Works. 1.5 hrs

Greenfield Elem. Quarterly PM on all 4 units. Filters, belts on 2 and 3, washed condensers, checked amps all within spec. Unit 4 has a small refrigerant leak somewhere, added 2 lbs to get them through, needs a leak search. 4 hrs
Sutter med plaza b. rtu-3 again. same leak area. redid the braze. 2
Hillview Dental. Customer says new tstat is confusing. Spent time showing them how to use the schedule. No parts. .5
Mission Linen, installed the belimo actuator we ordered, economizer modulating correctly now. tested at min and full. 2hrs

Emergency call, Delta Foods, walk in freezer at 28 deg. Found the condensing unit off on high head. Condenser coil packed solid with lint and dust. Cleaned thoroughly, restarted, pulling down normal now. Told the manager they need to be on a PM schedule for this, it's going to keep happening. 3 hours including travel
cordova bp. checked suite 110 again per customer, heat working fine. no charge?
Westbrook Tower. Chiller alarm, low evap temp fault. Reset and monitored for an hour, no repeat. Flow switch looks marginal, might be the cause. Recommend replacing flow switch next visit. 2.5

Sutter Medical Plaza building A. RTU-1. Supply fan VFD faulting on overcurrent. VFD is an ABB ACS310, appears to be failing internally. Unit installed 2023 per the tag so the VFD may be under warranty, need to check with the supplier. Bypassed to get them cooling for now, running across the line. 4 hrs
Greenfield leak search on unit 4. Found leak at the TXV bulb connection, tightened and leak checked good. Added 1 lb. 2 hrs

Old bakery 16th st, rescheduled from before. Ancient Rheem package unit. Heat exchanger is cracked, I red tagged it and shut off the gas. Owner needs to replace the whole unit, it's 24 years old. Wrote up a quote request. 1.5

Riverside FP. Replaced evaporator coil on the Goodman. Coil came in as a warranty part from Johnstone, no charge on the coil. Labor 6 hrs, two of us for 3. Also replaced the filter drier and pulled a good vacuum, 350 microns. Charged per nameplate.
mission linen pm. filters belts coils. 3
no access, gate locked
Sutter A rtu-1. Installed new VFD. Supplier confirmed it was in warranty so the drive came free, we just billed labor. 3.5 hrs. Tested at all speeds, BAS is reading it correctly.
Cordova Business Park - suite 240 too cold. Found the wrong tstat wired to the wrong zone from some previous work, not ours. Swapped the wires at the panel. 1 hr. Suite 240 and 250 were reversed.
Delta foods. Replaced condenser fan motor on unit 2 that I flagged a couple weeks ago. 1/2 hp 208v. Also new run cap with it. 2 hrs
Hillview Dental annual maintenance. Both split systems. Filters, cleaned condensers, checked charge both good, flushed drain lines, one was starting to plug. 2.5 hrs
westbrook, replaced flow switch on chiller. no more faults. 2
Greenfield Elementary. Cafeteria unit making a loud noise. Blower wheel is out of balance, one of the blades is bent. Wheel needs replacement, it's a 12x12 DD. Ordered. Ran it on low for now. 1.5 hrs
Sutter B. Tenant in suite 305 complaining about noise from the ceiling. Went up in the plenum, the flex duct had come loose from the boot and was whipping. Re-strapped and sealed. 1 hr

Mission Linen. Boiler low water cutoff tripping intermittently. Probe was scaled up. Cleaned probe, tested, holding. This is a symptom of their water treatment not being maintained, mentioned it to the plant manager. 2 hrs
Delta Foods. Installed the new blower wheel. Wait, this was Greenfield not Delta. Greenfield cafeteria unit, installed the blower wheel, balanced, no more noise. 2 hrs
riverside. checkup on the coil we did. running great, customer happy. no charge courtesy call. 45 min

Cordova. Unit 5 Lennox KGA120. Not cooling. Contactor pitted bad and the compressor is drawing high amps on start. Replaced contactor, compressor started ok but I don't love the amp draw. Unit is from 2019 so out of the 5 yr parts. Recommend they budget for a replacement compressor or a new unit. 2.5

Sutter Medical Plaza bldg B RTU 3. THIRD time on this leak. The suction line has been brazed twice and it's leaking adjacent to the previous repair now. I think the line set has a manufacturing defect or was damaged during install. Unit went in Aug 2024, definitely under the 5 year parts warranty. Recommend we file a claim and get the line set covered rather than keep brazing it. I charged it again, 5 lbs. 3 hrs. We have now spent about 9 hours on this.
westbrook tower monthly. filters on all ahus, checked chiller log, everything nominal. 3

Hillview. Drain line plugged again on the east unit, water in the pan. Vacuumed out, flushed with nitrogen, added a pan tab. They have a lot of dust from the construction next door, told them we should check it monthly until that's done. 1 hr
Delta Foods walk in cooler. Door gasket torn, warm air infiltrating. Replaced gasket. Also the door closer is weak. 1.5 hrs
Greenfield. PM. 3.5
Old bakery. Met with owner and the GC about the replacement unit. Took measurements, curb is nonstandard will need an adapter. No repair work. 2 hrs

Cordova business park. Suite 110 no heat AGAIN. Same igniter failed. This is the second one in a month. Either we got a bad batch or there's something causing them to crack, probably short cycling from an oversized unit. Replaced igniter under our own warranty, no charge to customer. 1.5 hrs. Somebody should look at the sizing.
Mission Linen. Replaced the boiler LWCO probe with a new one, the cleaning didn't hold. McDonnell Miller 750. 2 hrs
Sutter A. Rtu-2 and rtu-4 filter change and belt inspection. Rtu-4 belt replaced, BX42. 2

Westbrook. Chiller annual. Oil analysis pulled and sent to lab, cleaned tubes, checked all safeties, calibrated the low temp cutout. Compressor hours at 31400. Everything in good shape. Full day, 8 hrs.

Delta Foods. Unit 1 Carrier 48TC, the one we did the compressor on back in Sept 2024 under warranty, it's tripping on high pressure now. Condenser is clean. Suspect the txv or a restriction. Need more time to diagnose, customer wants us back Monday. 2 hrs today
